lockedEarly.title: The issuer takes all its principal, before it has vested
lockedEarly.detail: Locked(0, 1000000000000000000): Only 0.00% of the issuer's principal is withdrawable now. This asks for 100.00%.

propose1.title: The issuer proposes a new curator
propose1.detail: the timelock starts: 15 minutes, in public

propose.title: The issuer proposes the new curator again
propose.detail: 0xD570E1dAd01264178b5218246E74e0A961b0900c may take over from 17:49 UTC, 15 minutes on

acceptEarly.title: A stranger accepts the change at once
acceptEarly.detail: TimelockActive(1795110599): The curator change is still inside its timelock: 14m to go. Holders have this window to react.

transferIssuer.title: The issuer hands its role to a second key

strangerIssuer.title: A stranger tries to take the issuer role
strangerIssuer.detail: NotPendingIssuer(): Only the proposed issuer can accept the issuer role.

acceptIssuer.title: The second key accepts the issuer role

issuerBack.title: The original issuer accepts it back

flashSell.title: Dump 5,000 ticks…
flashSell.detail: 502 CVQ offered, spot -87513 → -92513 at most, in the same block

flashBuy.title: …and buy it straight back
flashBuy.detail: 0.0152 ETH, spot back to -87512; TWAP before -87513, after -87513

flashCheck.title: The curator reshapes: is the guard fooled?
flashCheck.detail: the guard passes: as far as the average is concerned nothing happened (TWAP -87512)

accept.title: A stranger accepts once the timelock has run

newCuratorRug.title: The new curator moves the support away
newCuratorRug.detail: SupportBroken(280, 4000): support would have been 2.8%, the covenant needs 40.0%. A new curator is bound by the same rules

curatorShares.title: The new curator withdraws shares it does not hold
curatorShares.detail: InsufficientShares(0, 10000000000000000): This address holds no vault shares. The curator has no withdrawal path at all.

curatorPrincipal.title: The new curator asks for the issuer's principal
curatorPrincipal.detail: NotIssuer(): Only the issuer can do this.

principalOut.title: The issuer takes a quarter of its vested principal
principalOut.detail: 0.00379 ETH and 23.93 CVQ to the treasury: a proportional slice of every range, so the shape and support are unchanged

lpJoin.title: An outside LP joins for a tenth of the vault
lpJoin.detail: 0.00114 ETH and 7.18 CVQ: a tenth of every range, in kind

dump.title: The price is pushed 2,500 ticks down
dump.detail: spot -87512 → -90011, 2500 ticks from the TWAP (the guard allows 300)

guardReshape.title: The curator reshapes at the manipulated price
guardReshape.detail: PriceGuard(90011, 87513): Spot is 2498 ticks from the time-weighted price. Nothing can change until the price has held.

guardDeposit.title: The LP deposits at the manipulated price
guardDeposit.detail: PriceGuard(90011, 87513): Spot is 2498 ticks from the time-weighted price. Nothing can change until the price has held.

guardRestore.title: A keeper calls restore at the manipulated price
guardRestore.detail: PriceGuard(90011, 87513): Spot is 2498 ticks from the time-weighted price. Nothing can change until the price has held.

lpExitTripped.title: The LP leaves while the guard is tripped
lpExitTripped.detail: every share out, with spot 2498 ticks from the TWAP: exits are never guarded, a proportional burn cannot be priced wrong

pump.title: The attacker buys every ask and pushes 30,000 ticks up
pump.detail: 71.78 CVQ bought; price 0.0001584 → 0.003181 ETH, through empty ticks

quickRestore.title: Two hours on, a restore to drag the bids up under the pump
quickRestore.detail: NothingToRestore(6689, 4000): support still reads 66.9% against 40.0%: the asks the attacker bought are quote just under the old price, and they count

poke1.title: A keeper syncs the Anchor (1)
poke1.detail: the Anchor is committed at tick -86762, 750 above where the pump began; support reads 66.9%

poke2.title: A keeper syncs the Anchor (2)
poke2.detail: the Anchor is committed at tick -86133, 1379 above where the pump began; support reads 55.7%

poke3.title: A keeper syncs the Anchor (3)
poke3.detail: the Anchor is committed at tick -85501, 2011 above where the pump began; support reads 45.6%

poke4.title: A keeper syncs the Anchor (4)
poke4.detail: the Anchor is committed at tick -84872, 2640 above where the pump began; support reads 35.0%

poke5.title: A keeper syncs the Anchor (5)
poke5.detail: the Anchor is committed at tick -84243, 3269 above where the pump began; support reads 24.1%

poke6.title: A keeper syncs the Anchor (6)
poke6.detail: the Anchor is committed at tick -83615, 3897 above where the pump began; support reads 12.9%

poke7.title: A keeper syncs the Anchor (7)
poke7.detail: the Anchor is committed at tick -82987, 4525 above where the pump began; support reads 1.3%

poke8.title: A keeper syncs the Anchor (8)
poke8.detail: the Anchor is committed at tick -82360, 5152 above where the pump began; support reads 0.0%

patientRestore.title: Held 5.0 hours (5.0 epochs), synced: a restore to drag the bids up
patientRestore.detail: RestoreBandEmpty(-83820, -84420): support reads 0.0%, lapsed, but the band sits above every price the vault has sold at. Restore refuses rather than chase the pump

sellBack.title: The attacker sells everything back
sellBack.detail: 71.78 CVQ sold, price 0.003181 → 0.0001585 ETH. The attacker ends -0.000097067329 ETH, gas included: the swap fees stay with the vault

curatorFees.title: The new curator claims its fee share
curatorFees.detail: 0.00000456298 ETH and 0.0583 CVQ to the curator

collect.title: A stranger collects the principal's fees
collect.detail: 0 ETH and 0.698 CVQ to the treasury

lpClaim.title: The LP claims what it earned while it held
lpClaim.detail: 0 ETH and 0.0203 CVQ to the LP
